notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 2 life this turn.
description:
Cast Whirlwind Technique by paying its mana cost reduced by Ezzaroot Channeler, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost reduced by Ezzaroot Channeler.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Whirlwind Technique targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve Whirlwind Technique, airbending Naru Meha.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha from exile by paying {0} due to Ezzaroot Channeler.
Repeat from step 3.
